responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_builtin_macros/src/assert/context.rs: Builds the expanded `assert!` AST for richer assertion failures by walking the asserted condition, identifying and deduplicating capturable subexpressions, generating the temporary bindings and `Capture` state needed to record values, assembling the formatted panic message, and wrapping the final condition check with the required imports and `unlikely` failure branch.
